consumer: avatar_action::move's destination-occupant resolution, asking 'what does the engine do when the avatar steps onto a tile occupied by a friendly NPC' (swap/displace) vs a wall (blocked no-op)
scope: the destination tile's occupant-resolution branch (friendly NPC -> swap, hostile -> melee, impassable terrain -> blocked), not just a fired/not-fired boolean
decisive_source: src/handle_action.cpp::game::handle_action — the ACTION_MOVE_* dispatch only calls avatar_action::move and keeps a single 'moved' bool, discarding the friendly-swap vs blocked vs attack distinction the goal needs
divergence: Avatar steps into a tile holding a friendly NPC: the engine swaps the two critters' positions; the dispatch's 'moved' boolean cannot distinguish this swap from a plain move onto empty terrain or from a wall-blocked no-op, so the proposed surface misreports the friendly-NPC behavior
